notes: ITU-T P.57 Type 4.3 ear on a head and torso simulator, reference state. Overrides: {"drive_mW":0.01,"fidelity":1,"front_plug":"mesh","load":"type43","pinna_volume_cm3":10,"rear_plug":"mesh","residual_leak_gap_mm":0.05,"source_impedance_ohm":0}. Centre the cup on the ear canal entrance as far as the pinna allows, with 5 N of clamping force (headband or a calibrated spring). The pinna's acoustics are not modelled: the model sees it only as a volume taken from the front cavity (pinna_volume_cm3, an estimate) and a larger residual leak.
